pedantic.description: Control whether validation enforces strict coherence of the include and link dependencies, including not permitting linking with PUBLIC scope when only INTERFACE scope is required.

targets.description: Per-target config keyed by target name.

allow_includes.description: A list of targets this target may include without linking, or a boolean controlling whether all targets may be included without linking.

allow_links.description: A list of targets this target may link without including, or a boolean controlling whether all targets may be linked without including.

interface_allow_includes.description: Control whether other targets may include this target without linking to it.

interface_allow_links.description: Control whether other targets may link to this target without including it.

ignore.description: Control whether all validation of this target is skipped.

interface_include_prefixes.description: Prefix strings used to disambiguate headers belonging to this target when its interface include directories overlap with another target.
